title: Repair an overflow-prone bounds check
prompt: Return whether length bytes starting at offset fit in a buffer of size bytes. An empty range at size is allowed. Avoid addition that can wrap around size_t.
signature: bool fits(std::size_t offset, std::size_t length, std::size_t size)

tests.label: Exact end
tests.hint: A range may end exactly at size.

tests.label: Too long
tests.hint: The remaining space is only two bytes.

tests.label: Empty at end
tests.hint: An empty range at the end is allowed.

tests.label: Offset outside
tests.hint: Validate the offset even when length is zero.

tests.label: Wraparound attack
tests.hint: Do not let offset+length wrap into a small value.

hints: First check that offset is no greater than size.
Only then is size-offset safe to compute.
explanation: The && operator evaluates its right side only after the left side is true. That makes the subtraction safe and avoids overflow-prone addition.
